scope: Selected BOLTS hexagonnut2 and hexagonnut1 dimensional rows adapted as separate DIN 934:1987 and ISO 4032:2012 reference families. Primary cross-checks and their edition/date limits are explicit per entry. All 19 source rows are retained unchanged; the BOLTS ISO-labeled M7 is excluded because ISO 4032:2012 has no M7 row. Across flats use s nominal=max and height uses m max as disclosed modeling references. The sharp regular hexagon derives its ideal corner diameter from s; source e_min remains provenance, not an independently imposed corner diameter. Coarse pitch is verified separately because BOLTS nut rows contain no pitch. Native recipes use the shared JIS B 0205-2/4:2001 nominal-basic internal thread, with modeled and cosmetic representation handled explicitly. Dimensional tolerances, external/end chamfers, washer faces, thread-entry mouth details, material, grade, coating and stock are unspecified or omitted. No ISO 965 fit class, current-standard compliance, strength, physical/gage fit or print-success certification. No ISO 4032:2023 dimensions are mixed into these families.
